chunks: Ibn Mahbub narrated from Abu Walad, from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام, who said:
Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام used to say: “The diyyah for accidental killing is to be paid over three years, and the diyyah for intentional killing is to be paid within one year.”

key_terms.دِيَةُ ٱلْخَطَإِ: the blood money due for accidental killing
key_terms.دِيَةُ ٱلْعَمْدِ: the blood money due for intentional killing

ai.seo_question: How long does it take to pay the diyyah for accidental versus intentional killing in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling on the timing of diyyah payments in two different cases of homicide. The diyyah for accidental killing is spread over three years, whereas the diyyah for intentional killing is to be paid within one year, showing a distinction in legal treatment based on the nature of the act.
